The local Shimadzu workbench accepts raw and sample/internal-standard .xlsx workbooks and runs browser-local Stage 0-6 processing.
Requires declared input/output units, zero-area QC, row lineage, and unchanged original-file hash.
Requires read-only originals and separate outputs; on hash mismatch, stop promotion and preserve source plus diagnostics.
finalIsConcentration supports pre-spike/include; semiquantify uses area ratio with fixed RRF=1 and returns INVALID_INTERNAL_STANDARD_AREA for zero IS area.
Stage 4 output concentration columns use μg/mL; zero or unavailable IS area keeps concentration NA with an issue. Manifest lists source-file SHA-256 values.
Routing specifies both selected skills for GC-MS quantitation and no scientific skill for navigation text. Reference document states that μg/mL to μg/g conversion has no verified contract here.

execution.command: node --input-type=module -e 'import {finalIsConcentration,semiquantify} from "./frontend/src/shimadzu-core/semiquant.mjs"; import {createHash} from "node:crypto"; const c=finalIsConcentration({stockUgMl:100,spikeUl:10,systemMl:5,basis:"pre-spike",method:"include"}); const valid=semiquantify({analyteArea:200,isArea:100,isConcentration:c}); const invalid=semiquantify({analyteArea:0,isArea:0,isConcentration:c}); const bytes=Buffer.from("synthetic GC-MS source fixture v1","utf8"); const actual=createHash("sha256").update(bytes).digest("hex"); const expected="0".repeat(64); console.log(JSON.stringify({isUgMl:c,valid,invalid,hashBoundary:{actual,expected,matches:actual===expected,action:actual===expected?"promote":"stop"}},null,2))'
execution.reference_test_observed: 3 tests passed, 0 failed. Existing tests include pre-spike/ignore and include volume references plus zero IS-area boundary.

decision.mass_balance: 100 µg/mL × 0.010 mL = 1 µg added internal-standard mass. Final liquid volume is 5.010 mL, so internal-standard concentration is 1/5.010 = 0.1996007984 µg/mL. Assuming the code's fixed RRF=1, sample 1 is (200/100) × 0.1996007984 = 0.3992015968 µg/mL extract.
decision.invalid_row: Sample 2 has zero IS area, so division is invalid even though analyte area is also zero. Keep the source row and original measured areas, emit NA and FAIL/INVALID_INTERNAL_STANDARD_AREA in row-level QC; do not write 0 concentration, impute an IS area without the required donor evidence, or claim detection.
decision.unit_boundary: Neither sample can be written as µg/g from these inputs. At minimum, original sample mass and final extract volume, dilution or aliquot factors, recovery policy, and sample matrix basis must be defined and validated. The calculated number is an extract solution semiquantitation under RRF=1, not a calibrated mass fraction.
decision.source_workbook: Do not overwrite or delete the original workbook. Record its byte SHA-256, preserve the source, and write any authorized derived result to a separate versioned output with lineage and QC; no actual workbook was used in this probe.
decision.hash_mismatch: The synthetic in-memory SHA-256 intentionally differs from the expected hash. Stop import or output promotion, retain the original and diagnostic artifacts, verify source identity and expected manifest before retrying. The comparison was an in-memory boundary demonstration, not a call to an existing project hash-verification function.

limitations: Synthetic numbers and bytes only; no actual Excel workbook, source-row ID, or original-file hash was available to test.
